title: Statistical analysis code for age-specific prognostic contrasts in cholangiocarcinoma
description: R code and non-identifiable aggregate result files for a population-based analysis of age-related heterogeneity in cancer-specific mortality contrasts between intrahepatic and extrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma and, where EOD schema coding is available, among intrahepatic, perihilar, and distal cholangiocarcinoma. The repository contains no SEER records, derived patient-level data, or manuscript files.
